note: manah 'achat 'appayim ("one portion of two faces/nostrils") is obscure. It is read as "a double portion", "a special portion", or (by emendation) "only one portion although he loved her".
The MT has befarim sheloshah ("with three bulls"). I follow the Septuagint and 4QSam-a, which read befar meshullash ("with a three-year-old bull"), as v. 25 mentions "the bull" in the singular.
bat-beliyya'al is an idiom for "worthless person". As in Deut 13:14, the KJV treats it as a name.
